experiments.name: Copying FOMO app traders
experiments.question: Can we front-run or copy the best FOMO app wallets?
experiments.method: On-chain audit of 60+ wallets, 7-day forward test
experiments.result: Winners churn; copying after the fact loses to fees and slippage.

experiments.name: Technical signals on liquid memecoins
experiments.question: Does any TA entry beat random in 27 liquid memecoins?
experiments.result: Every strategy lost 2–5% per trade; none beat random.

experiments.name: Tweet sniper on fresh launches
experiments.question: Do influencer tweets predict pumps early enough to buy?
experiments.method: Dataset of tweets vs. 6h outcomes, shadow run
experiments.result: Signals arrive after the move; snipers own the first minutes.

experiments.name: Anti-rug: common-funder clustering
experiments.question: Can we detect rugs by tracing who funded the top holders?
experiments.method: Helius funded-by on top-20 holders + deployer history, applied live
experiments.result: Caught 3 concentrated tokens before buying (CHICO, tSpaceX, LMAO!).

experiments.name: Perps signals on Hyperliquid
experiments.question: Any short-term long/short edge in perps (funding, cascades, breakouts, pairs)?
experiments.method: 34 markets, 90 days, real funding, out-of-sample, random control
experiments.result: None passed (t ≥ 2.5 and beat random). Volume breakouts lose clearly (−1.5%/trade).

experiments.name: Fast momentum in $300K–3M memecoins
experiments.question: Does buying small caps already up 100%+ 'on a pullback' work with 12h time stops?
experiments.result: Both stopped out within an hour (−26%, −28%). Turned off the same night.

experiments.name: Stops that only move up
experiments.question: Does ratcheting the stop with the peak keep more of the winners?
experiments.method: Live on GTA6/REMUS; rules 1.3x→entry, 1.6x→75% of peak
experiments.result: REMUS closed +14% instead of round-tripping; GTA6 protected at 1.3x.
